title: Casascius Explorer
description: Explore Casascius coins and bars with interactive 3D views, mintage details, active and redeemed status, and recent spend activity

title: Bitcoin Net Worth
description: This dashboard tracks Bitcoin-denominated net worth across assets and liabilities with snapshot history, charting, and optional local encryption for live data

title: Patoshi Pattern
description: Explore early Bitcoin ExtraNonce patterns, Patoshi-classified blocks, spent block rewards, and difficulty markers across custom block-time ranges

title: Unit of Account
description: Compares any selected currency pair in both directions using historical rates, mirrored charts, date-range controls, and optional redenomination adjustment

title: DCA Cost Basis
description: This dashboard tracks Bitcoin weighted-average DCA cost basis across daily, weekly, and monthly cadences and compares it to spot price

title: Moving Average
description: Compare two configurable Bitcoin moving averages across days, weeks, or calendar months, with trailing-window charts and historical playback

title: Epoch-Over-Epoch Growth
description: Align Bitcoin halving epochs by block count to compare their price paths and price growth relative to the preceding epoch, with historical playback

title: Days Since ATH
description: Tracks Bitcoin all-time-high price, daily high, drawdown, and days since the most recent ATH with notebook-inspired two-panel charts

title: Issuance Rate
description: Replay Bitcoin's annualized issuance rate with epoch-aware halving transitions and notebook-matched playback controls

title: Mined Supply & Price
description: Explore Bitcoin mined supply by halving epoch beside the historical BTC/USD price, with date playback and image or video exports

title: Price Distribution
description: Explore daily Bitcoin prices by price range, with historical playback and image or video exports

title: DCA Comparison
description: Compares two assets dollar cost averaged with the same start date, cadence, and purchase amount against a USD savings baseline

title: Bitcoin Dominance
description: This dashboard shows Bitcoin's share of market cap relative to the top cryptocurrencies

title: Node Count
description: This dashboard tracks Bitcoin node count over time and the software versions nodes are running

title: BIP-110 Signaling
description: This dashboard focuses on miner signaling across each 2,016-block period for BIP-110, with SegWit signaling periods included for historical comparison

title: Bitcoin Quantum Exposure
description: Discontinued research dashboard. The last published legacy snapshot is block 961,000; no new Quantum snapshots are scheduled. An audit found accounting and methodology limitations, and no validated replacement was published. Historical views remain available with those limitations.
